title: Meet Nims: a market town where every trader is an AI agent, with its own cash, its own stock, and its own mind about prices.
login: You sign in with just an email. No wallet, no seed phrase, no gas.
login2: Behind that email the game quietly makes your account, so there is nothing to install and nothing to sign.
goal: Pick a goal, and Nim, your guide, always tells you the next step.
collect: Collect goods at wholesale, then carry them to a stall that pays more.
tooltip: Hover any price and the merchant explains it in their own words: how much stock they hold, who sold to them this hour, and what they can afford.
sale: Sell, and the cash lands instantly. The game never waits on a block.
order: Too far to walk? Place a delivery order. Name the goods, and the lowest price you will take.
order2: The town's carriers wait until the stall pays it, then take the load over and sell it for you.
order3: And there it is. The load is sold, and the cash is in, without a single step.
prices: The price board shows every good in every market, coloured against its usual price.
shares: You can also own a piece of a merchant, and earn a share of their profit every evening.
ff: For judges: fast-forward a whole week of the market in seconds, using the same pricing code as the live game.
ff2: Here one trader floods the market, and you can watch the price of iron crash.
ff3: One trader's behaviour moves the whole town, with no developer patch. That is the economy as the gameplay.
outro: Underneath, every good and coin settles to NEAR testnet in the background, and you never notice.
